v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce quam bonum * et quam iucúndum habitáre fratres in unum. ‡
text.en: Behold how good * and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. ‡

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for he was mindful of us in our affliction.

text.la: Adhǽreat lingua mea * fáucibus meis, si non memínero tui Ierúsalem.
text.en: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws * if I do not remember thee, Jerusalem.

text.la: Confitébor * nómini tuo, Dómine, super misericórdia et veritáte tua.
text.en: I will give glory * to thy name, for thy mercy, and for thy truth.

text.la: Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
text.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

text.la: Fecit Deus * poténtiam in brácchio suo: dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
text.en: God has shown * the power of his arm: he has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

text.la: Largíre nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, semper spíritum cogitándi quæ recta sunt, propítius et agéndi: ut, qui sine te esse non póssumus, secúndum te vívere valeámus.
text.en: Grant to us, Lord, we beseech thee, the spirit to think and do always such things as be rightful, that we, who cannot do anything that is good without thee, may by thee be enabled to live according to thy will.

office.title: Feria quinta infra Hebd VIII post Octavam Pentecostes
